desc:

title: File:2025 Sakharov Prize- Parliament honours Andrzej Poczobut and Mzia Amaglobeli.jpg
desc:
President Metsola awarded the 2025 Sakharov Prize to the representatives of the two journalists, who are imprisoned in Belarus and Georgia, at a ceremony on Tuesday 16 December in Strasbourg.
For more information: www.europarl.europa.eu/news/en/press-room/20251211IPR3216...
